settings.question: Who qualifies for the Asmaan Ambassador Program?
settings.answer: We look for dedicated creators, athletes, designers, founders, and students who have an active digital voice and genuinely align with clean cognitive performance and thoughtful aesthetics. Quality of content and engagement matter more than raw follower numbers.

settings.question: How and when do I get paid?
settings.answer: Commissions are tracked in real-time via your custom affiliate link or discount code. Payouts are distributed monthly via direct bank transfer or PayPal.

settings.question: What is included in the creator welcome package?
settings.answer: Accepted ambassadors receive a complimentary shipment of Asmaan Ambition Tonic cases, custom merchandise from our active capsule, and personalized creator promotional collateral.

settings.question: What are my commitments as an ambassador?
settings.answer: We ask for 1 to 2 authentic posts, reels, or stories per month featuring Asmaan in your real routine (working, training, designing, or studying), along with sharing your community discount code.
